name: White Cobalt
tagline: Save videos and media from the internet with one tap
description:
White Cobalt is a native Android app for saving videos and media from the internet, built on top of the open source cobalt tools. Paste a link from a site you're browsing, and it fetches the media for you to keep.

It's a lightweight, native alternative to using cobalt through a website, built specifically to feel at home on your phone.
